reponse:
The two flags from Martin on the Nov 12 sync, and what happened after:

**1. Webhook signature failures** — Ellen Vance's team: ~95% of `payout.paid` and `seller.verified` sandbox webhooks failed HMAC verification, so they'd disabled it. ✅ Picked up and fixed: Jake Whitfield took it on the call [1], root cause was signing a re-serialized body instead of the raw bytes (PR core#1187, merged and deployed to sandbox Nov 16, production with release 2026.47 on Nov 24) [2]. Ellen turned verification back on Nov 17: 300+ events, all verifying ✅ [3].

**2. Per-seller payout schedules** — Tradewell's ~200 top sellers are on net-7, everyone else net-30; Quillon only supports one platform-wide schedule. ⚠️ Picked up, but not solved: Owen promised an answer by Friday Nov 20 [3]; it's ticketed as QPAY-2362, estimated at 3–4 weeks, and Avi Kessler ruled it out for Dec 7 ("not touching the batcher three weeks before a contractual go-live"), pushing it to backlog / 2027-Q1 [11]. As of Nov 17 Martin was still chasing Owen for the answer he needs for seller comms [3]. Note the MSA summary lists only "one platform-wide payout schedule" as in scope at go-live [5] — so this is effectively a scope change request, and it's unresolved.
